Safety is the product

Meeting someone new should feel easy. These are built in, not optional.

ID-verified companions

Every companion’s ID and photo are checked by our team before they can meet anyone.

Public places only

Cafés, galleries, parks and events. You choose the place when you book.

Full refund if nobody accepts

You pay up front; if no companion confirms in time, every rupee comes back.

A panic button that reaches us

Hold for three seconds during a session and our team is alerted at once, again every five minutes until it is resolved.

Your number stays private

Chat opens once a booking is confirmed, and phone numbers are hidden automatically.

Photos reviewed by people

A real person approves every profile photo before it is shown.

Earn as a companion, on your terms

Choose the lengths you offer and the hours you are free. You receive 80% of every booking, the same fair price for everyone, and you only meet in public places.

Questions

Is this a dating app?

No. prsnn is for company: coffee, walks, events, study sessions and plans. Every meeting is in a public place, and conversations stay about the plan.

How much does it cost?

From ₹399 for one hour, and less per hour for longer bookings. There is no booking fee.

What if I need to cancel?

Cancel 15 minutes or more before the start and 85% comes back to you. If your companion cancels, you get everything back.

Can I book for someone else?

Yes. Book company for a parent, a friend or anyone you care about, and add their details at checkout.

Your next plan doesn’t have to be a solo one.
